info.title: StellarSafe API
info.description:
Off-chain coordination layer for StellarSafe treasuries: wallet sign-in, indexed treasury state, proposal metadata, audit trail and notifications.

**The Soroban contracts are the source of truth.** This API never signs, approves or executes payments; indexed data can lag the chain and must not be treated as authority.

verified.description: Email subscriptions receive nothing until the address is confirmed

treasuryId.description: null = all treasuries you are a member of

verified.description: Email subscriptions receive nothing until the address is confirmed

treasuryId.description: null = all treasuries you are a member of

secret.description: Webhook HMAC signing secret. Returned only on create and rotate; store it securely.

id.description: On-chain proposal id (u64 as decimal string)

amount.description: Amount in the token's smallest unit (i128 as decimal string)

policyOutdated.description: True when the treasury policy changed after this proposal; the contract will reject execution

status.description: `pending` until the contract initialization event is indexed

policy.description: Latest indexed policy. The chain is authoritative.

historyComplete.description: False when part of the history fell outside the RPC retention window before indexing

get.summary: Readiness probe: database, RPC and indexer lag
get.description: Returns 503 when the database is unreachable. RPC or indexer problems are reported as `degraded`.

post.description: Returns a one-time challenge. `message` mode is signed with SEP-53 (`signMessage` in Freighter and most wallets). `transaction` mode returns a SEP-10 challenge transaction (hardware wallets). Challenges are single-use and short-lived.

post.summary: Exchange a signed challenge for tokens

post.description: Refresh tokens are single-use. Presenting a rotated token revokes the whole session.

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: Only treasuries where this account is a member

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when done

post.summary: Register a deployed treasury contract for indexing
post.description: Verifies the contract exists on the configured network (and matches a trusted WASM hash, if configured), then backfills its events from `startLedger` (default: oldest ledger retained by RPC).

get.summary: Live token balances read from chain

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Comma-separated token contract IDs; defaults to tokens seen in proposals

post.summary: Store a proposal description and get its content hash
post.description: Call before proposing on-chain, then pass the returned `metadataHash` to `propose_payment`. Metadata is content-addressed, immutable and only linked to proposals that commit to its hash.

get.summary: Get proposal metadata by content hash
Audit trail: indexed on-chain events and off-chain actions, newest first

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when done

get.summary: Export the audit trail as CSV (oldest first, max 10,000 rows)

post.summary: Create a webhook or email subscription
post.description: Webhook deliveries are signed: `X-StellarSafe-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>`. Email subscriptions use double opt-in: a confirmation link is sent and nothing else is delivered until it is confirmed. Only events from treasuries where you are a current member are delivered.

patch.summary: Update a subscription (re-enabling resets the failure counter)

post.summary: Resend the email confirmation link (invalidates the previous one)
